Network Service Group Z Resource Edit Network Service Group
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/networkServiceGroups/:serviceGroupId

Creates a network service group based on the service group ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
serviceGroupId
int32
REQUIRED

The ID of the network service group.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
id
int32

ID of the network service group.

name
string

Name of the network service group.

services
object[]
description
string

Description of the network service group.

creatorContext
string

Indicates whether the network service group is created in Cloud & Branch Connector (EC) or ZIA.

Possible values: [ZIA, EC]

Responses
​
default

default response

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
